title: Cell-based expansion
objective: Add an isolated application cell and migrate a selected tenant through controlled state and routing handoff, rejecting routes before synchronized exclusive ownership.
infrastructure: N/A: resource-free offline lesson; no IaC or resource operations.
preconditions: A owns alpha and beta at epoch 1
Two ready A workers provide 100 synthetic rps
expectedAssertions: Created B has isolated storage and two distinct synthetic workers; allocation alone proves no migration
A source write invalidates an older copy and blocks transfer and routing
Only synchronized healthy B can exclusively own the selected tenant at epoch 2
Old epoch-1 writes are rejected without missing or duplicated acknowledged writes
The unaffected tenant remains usable and owned by A
HTTP 200 with wrong business state is failure; missing observations are unknown
Failures and unknowns remain cumulative after recovery and in bounded archived history
limits: 4 page-memory archived runs with counted eviction
No native, production runtime, parent or reliability proof
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical acceptance pending; worker cannot award Done credit.
